description: Bulk Property Sales Information, NSW is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NSW Valuer General. The NSW Valuer General makes data on property sales available via downloadable tables on their website in.DAT format. The data is updated on Local Government Area boundaries and shows information related to property sales such as address, purchase price and land area. This includes historic data back to 1990. Coverage is the states and territories, 1990 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as weekly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
